Women's World Cup 2027 schedule

By VERIFY_PEN_NAME · Updated 2026-11-22

FIFA published the match schedule on 20 August 2026. It fixes the dates and venues of all 64 matches, but not the teams: those are set by the final draw on 11 December 2026.

Tournament dates

The tournament runs from Thursday 24 June to Sunday 25 July 2027. It starts with eight groups of four teams. The top two in each group reach the round of 16, followed by quarter-finals, semi-finals, a third-place match and the final.

Venues by round

RoundHost cities
Opening matchRio de Janeiro (Maracanã)
Group stageAll eight host cities
Round of 16Including Brasília, Porto Alegre, Recife and Salvador, whose last matches are in this round
Quarter-finalsBelo Horizonte, Fortaleza, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo
Semi-finalsRio de Janeiro and São Paulo
Third-place matchSão Paulo
FinalRio de Janeiro (Maracanã), 25 July 2027

Every host city stages at least seven matches, including at least one knockout match.

Brazil's group matches

DateStadium
Thursday 24 June 2027Estádio do Maracanã, Rio de Janeiro
Tuesday 29 June 2027Arena Itaquera, São Paulo
Sunday 4 July 2027Estádio Nacional, Brasília

Brazil's opponents will be known after the final draw.

Kickoff times

Kickoff times have not been announced yet. All eight host cities use Brasília time (UTC-3). The kickoff times page converts Brasília time to your time zone.
